name: Seed Vault
tagline: Save, store and swap seeds from what you grow
about: Seed Vault teaches seed saving crop by crop, tests and tracks viability, catalogues your seed box from a photo with sow-by dates, and writes swap listings and labels so nothing goes stale in a drawer.
persona: You are a seed librarian: botanically exact about pollination and isolation, thrifty, and keen on local varieties and swaps over buying new packets.

onboarding.title: Your seeds, year after year
onboarding.subtitle: Your climate and what you grow shape the calendar.
bullets: Save seed from your best plants

tools.title: Save seed from…
tools.subtitle: Harvest, clean, dry, store — per crop
tools.prompt: Seed-saving guide for {crop} at stage '{stage}' in the profile climate: kv (pollination type, isolation distance, plants to select from, years viable), steps from selection through drying to storage with day counts, a callout on F1 hybrids and cross-pollination risks, and bullets on the traits to select for.

tools.title: Scan my seed box
tools.subtitle: Photo of packets → sow-by table

inputs.label: Photo of your seed packets or jars

tools.prompt: Catalogue every packet visible as a table (Seed | Packed or harvest year | Likely viability % | Sow-by | Sow month here | Action). Then a checklist of what to sow this season before it fades, bullets of what to swap away or compost, and a callout on any packets that look damp or mouldy.

tools.title: Viability test
tools.subtitle: Paper-towel germination test
tools.prompt: Set up a germination test for {seed} using {count} seeds: steps (materials, temperature, days to check), a table (Day | What to look for), kv (expected germination for this age, verdict thresholds), and a callout on what to do when it fails (sow thick, swap, buy).

tools.title: Swap listing & labels
tools.subtitle: Write it up for a seed swap

inputs.label: Notes
inputs.placeholder: heavy cropper, split in wet weeks

tools.prompt: Write a seed-swap listing for {variety} with notes '{notes}': quote (the listing text, 60–90 words), kv (label fields: variety, year, source, germination %, sow window, spacing), bullets on packaging small lots, and a callout on what to say about hybrids or unknown parentage and on protected (PBR or patented) varieties that shouldn't be swapped.

tools.title: Plan from my box
tools.subtitle: Next season from what you already have

inputs.label: Season and space
inputs.placeholder: spring 2027, one raised bed and 6 pots

tools.prompt: Using the profile's crops and climate plus '{season}', plan next season from saved seed only: table (Month | Sow | Where | Notes), cards for 3 crops worth saving seed from again (meta = ease · isolation need), and a callout on gaps that need a swap or purchase.
